description: Agent Triage: submit the triage report written for the principal, with the queue records behind it: its title, its audience, the period it covers and its text, read for wording such as nothing falls through the cracks, zero backlog or inbox zero; whether it states the volume received in each class; for the items received, overdue, escalated, disposed and still open, whether the report states them, how many it names and whether each figure links to the queue records behind it; and optionally the record of items received in the period and, of those, overdue, escalated, disposed and still open. The signed report gives the report with any nothing-left-behind wording, each figure with whether it is stated, its count and whether it is backed by the records, and the record with the items unaccounted for, and names a report that inflates the queue record: figures misstated in the direction that flatters the queue (more received or disposed, fewer overdue, escalated or open), figures with no link to the records behind them, and wording such as nothing falls through the cracks while the record holds items unaccounted for, overdue or still open; then figures left out of the report, figures misstated the other way and volume with no breakdown by class, with the fix for each. This reports on an agent’s triage queue against its queue records: a group of agents’ report on its friction is wever_coordination-report-check, a kept-promises report is wever_commitment-report-check and a learning report is wever_learning-report-check. Verdict triage_report_inflated, triage_report_partial, triage_report_missing or triage_report_sound. POST /api/triage-report-check. Reads only the recorded queue items and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no item is captured, ranked, routed, escalated or closed and no queue is changed. Agent Triage reads how an agent sorts incoming work, from the item captured at intake to the disposition it ends with: it is not multi-agent coordination (how a group of agents organizes shared work, with its own escalation path, the wever_coordination checks; triage escalation is a single queue item breaching its threshold and moving up a tier, with its context attached), not the promises an agent has made (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; triage decides handling order and routing before any promise exists), not delegation (handing work off with authority, the wever_delegation checks; triage assigns incoming items to queues and owners, a sorting decision rather than a delegation) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the triage checks read a queue of items over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-triage-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-triage/.
